# Format: see r2_multi_value.txt. OCR scans give one table row per line with a wide gap of exactly three spaces between cells.
@@ R2 | M | 40 | scan cumulative columns, current is critical
Test   Previous   Current   Unit   Reference Range
Creatinine   1.1   9.8   mg/dL   0.7-1.3
Sodium   139   140   mmol/L   135-145
=> Creatinine | HIGH | 9.8
=> Sodium | NORMAL | 140
@@ R2 | M | 40 | scan cumulative columns, current first
Test   Current   Previous   Unit   Reference Range
Haemoglobin   6.2   13.9   g/dL   13.0-17.0
=> Haemoglobin | CRITICAL_LOW | 6.2
=> risk>=critical
@@ R2 | M | 40 | scan with dated columns, latest right
Test   03/02/2026   03/04/2026   Unit   Reference Range
Calcium   9.2   5.9   mg/dL   8.5-10.5
=> Calcium | CRITICAL_LOW | 5.9
@@ R2 | M | 40 | scan two panels, gap of three spaces
Test   Result Unit   Ref Range   Test   Result Unit Ref Range
Urea   30 mg/dL 15-45   Glucose   45 mg/dL 70-100
=> Urea | NORMAL | 30
=> Glucose | CRITICAL_LOW | 45
@@ R2 | M | 40 | scan two panels, numbers in names of the second panel
Test   Result   Unit   Ref   Test   Result   Unit   Ref
Sodium   138   mmol/L   135-145   Vitamin B 12   120   pg/mL   200-900
=> Sodium | NORMAL | 138
=> B 12 | LOW | 120
@@ R2 | M | 40 | scan three tests on one row
ALT   45 U/L 7-55   AST   40 U/L 8-48   ALP   500 U/L 40-129
=> ALT | NORMAL | 45
=> AST | NORMAL | 40
=> ALP | HIGH | 500
@@ R2 | M | 40 | cumulative column with trailing history annotation
Potassium 6.9 mmol/L 3.5-5.1 (prev 4.1 on 12/01/2026)
=> Potassium | CRITICAL_HIGH | 6.9
@@ R2 | M | 40 | date prefix before the test name
12/03/2026 Potassium 6.9 mmol/L 3.5-5.1
=> Potassium | CRITICAL_HIGH | 6.9
@@ R2 | M | 40 | unit in brackets before the value
Potassium [mmol/L] 6.9 3.5-5.1
=> Potassium | CRITICAL_HIGH | 6.9
@@ R2 | M | 40 | flag cell before the value
Potassium H 6.9 mmol/L 3.5-5.1
=> Potassium | CRITICAL_HIGH | 6.9
@@ R2 | M | 40 | pipe-delimited row
Sodium|128|mmol/L|135-145
=> Sodium | LOW | 128
@@ R2 | M | 40 | two bare numbers without a header
Sodium 139 140 mmol/L 135-145
=> Sodium | UNKNOWN
=> warn
=> risk=unknown
